m4-t1.question: What is FTE for six 40-hour and four 20-hour contracts at a 40-hour standard?
What is the headcount of that group?
m4-t1.explanation: Headcount counts the ten people, not hour equivalents.

m4-t1.question: What closing department count follows 20 + 3 + 2 − 1 − 2?
m4-t1.explanation: Include both external movements and department transfers.

m4-t1.question: What must be stated for an FTE calculation?
options: The hours basis and full-time standard
m4-t1.explanation: Without a standard and basis, FTE is ambiguous.

m4-t1.question: Why can headcount alone miss a capacity problem?
options: Every person always works identical hours
Hours, skills and availability can differ
m4-t1.explanation: Capacity depends on more than the number of people.

m4-t2.question: What is turnover for 11 exits and average headcount 110?
What is retention when 92 of an opening cohort of 100 remain?
m4-t2.explanation: Retention follows the opening cohort, not the turnover denominator.

m4-t2.question: What is absence rate for 80 of 2,000 scheduled hours?
What should accompany a turnover percentage?
options: Only a red or green colour
Period, counts, denominator and exit definition
m4-t2.explanation: Rates need context and consistent definitions.

m4-t2.question: What cannot be concluded from absence data alone?
options: An individual’s medical condition or misconduct
A need to review data quality
m4-t2.explanation: Aggregate measurement is not diagnosis or evidence of wrongdoing.

m4-t3.question: What FTE demand follows 9,600 cases at 800 cases per FTE?
m4-t3.explanation: 9,600/800 = 12 FTE under the stated capacity assumption.

m4-t3.question: What supply follows 10 current FTE plus 2 additions minus 1 departure?
At demand 12 and supply 11, what is the capacity gap?
Why include recruitment lead time?
options: Capacity may not arrive when the workload starts
It removes the need for approval
m4-t3.explanation: Hiring decisions and effective availability occur at different times.

m4-t3.question: Which is a suitable alternative to automatic hiring?
options: Evaluate internal mobility or process improvement with safeguards
m4-t3.explanation: Workforce responses should consider several responsible options.

questions.question: Eight people work 40 hours and four work 20 hours weekly. What are headcount and FTE at a 40-hour standard?
questions.explanation: Headcount is 12; total 400 hours divided by 40 is 10 FTE.

questions.question: A department opens at 30, has 4 joins, 3 exits, 2 transfers in and 1 transfer out. What is closing headcount?
Opening and closing headcounts are 80 and 100; there are 9 exits. What is period turnover using their simple average?
Of the original 80 employees, 74 remain at period end while new hires increased total headcount. What is opening-cohort retention?
questions.explanation: 74/80 = 92.5%; new hires do not enter that cohort denominator.

questions.question: Scheduled hours are 3,000 and included absence is 90 hours. What is the rate?
Why can one minus turnover differ from retention?
options: The populations and denominators can differ
Retention is always a count not a rate
questions.explanation: Opening-cohort retention and period turnover are distinct definitions.

questions.question: Demand is 12,000 cases at 1,000 cases per FTE. Supply is 10 plus 2 joins minus 1 departure. What is the gap?
A hiring plan counts every accepted offer as immediately productive FTE. What needs correction?
options: The fact that FTE equals salary
Joining uncertainty, start dates and onboarding availability
questions.explanation: Capacity arrives later and may differ from accepted offers.

questions.question: A monthly turnover rate is volatile in a small team. What should an analyst avoid?
options: Mechanically annualising it as a reliable forecast
questions.explanation: Short-period volatility makes naive annual projections misleading.

questions.question: The capacity model assumes all paid hours are case-processing hours. What should be reviewed?
options: Whether to omit all non-case work
Breaks, training, support work and sustainable quality constraints
questions.explanation: Productive capacity is not identical to total paid hours.
